description:
Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS is Alibaba's speech synthesis model, available here in two tiers with over 1,000 shared voices, 16 languages, and 20 Chinese dialect regions. Direct the delivery in plain English, or drop inline tags straight into your text to change expression mid-sentence.

Expression
- Instruction sets emotion, tone, character, pace, and style, for example "Speak quickly in an excited, upbeat tone"
- Inline tags change expression mid-sentence: [excited], [whispers], [laughing], [sighing], [gasp]

Notes
- Languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
